notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Minor bug fixes

Warning sounds will no longer play on the in-game results screen

Fixed issues with the settings screen UI and the application of graphic settings

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the achievement for launching the game.

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the game could not progress when playing New Game+.

notes.title: 1.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where bullet pattern movement would reset incorrectly

Fixed a problem with the ending dialog display

Fixed a UI issue occurring after boss battles

notes.title: [Notice] Game Release Date Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]First of all, thank you so much for your patience and support as we work on bringing this game to life.[/p][p]Due to adjustments in our development schedule, we are postponing the game’s release from the originally planned last week of July to August 27 (Wednesday).[/p][p]Initially, we had planned to launch the game in Early Access in late July and then release the full version about a month later, after further testing and balancing.[/p][p]However, after careful consideration, we’ve decided to skip the Early Access phase and move straight to a full release.[/p][p]As a result, the official release will take place on Wednesday, August 27, during the final week of August.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize to everyone who was looking forward to the original release date.[/p][p]We’re doing our utmost to deliver a polished and complete experience, and we truly appreciate your understanding and continued support.[/p][p]Thank you very much![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 0.8.34.d Patch
notes.content: Fixed the dialogue bug on Day 7 and Day 9 of the Daiyosei.

notes.title: 0.8.31.d Patch
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the game freezing in some situations after a boss fight.
